news.titleEn: Third Aircraft Carrier and Thousands of Troops Head to Mideast as Trump Weighs New Iran Strikes
news.conclusionEn: The US is sending about 9,000 sailors and Marines, led by the USS Theodore Roosevelt carrier group, toward the Middle East as Trump weighs renewed strikes on Iran.
news.conclusionZh: 美国增派约9000名官兵及第三艘航母前往中东，特朗普考虑再次打击伊朗。
news.whyEn: A bigger US military buildup raises the risk of renewed conflict with Iran, which keeps oil, shipping and defense stocks on edge.
news.whyZh: 军事集结加大美伊冲突风险，持续牵动油价、航运和国防股。
news.detailEn: The Theodore Roosevelt strike group left San Diego on Sept. 27 and the USS Makin Island amphibious group, carrying about 2,000 Marines, sailed a day later. Together they could bring three US carriers to the region by late October or November, lifting the US naval presence to more than 20,000 personnel. It is one of the largest US naval concentrations in the Gulf and Arabian Sea since the 2003 Iraq invasion. Markets will watch whether the buildup is deterrence or a prelude to new strikes, especially with US midterm elections on Nov. 3.
news.detailZh: 罗斯福号航母打击群9月27日从圣迭戈出发，载有约2000名海军陆战队员的马金岛号两栖戒备群次日启航。到10月底或11月，中东可能同时有三艘美国航母，美军海上兵力将超过2万人。这是2003年伊拉克战争以来美国在海湾和阿拉伯海最大规模的海军集结之一。市场将关注这是威慑还是新一轮打击的前奏，尤其是11月3日美国中期选举临近。

news.titleEn: Saudis plan major offensive against the Houthis, but U.S. won't join for now
news.conclusionEn: Saudi Arabia is preparing a ground and air offensive in Yemen to retake the Bab el-Mandeb strait from the Houthis, who seized it last month.
news.conclusionZh: 沙特筹划对胡塞武装发动攻势，夺回曼德海峡控制权。
news.whyEn: Bab el-Mandeb has become a key alternative to the Strait of Hormuz this year, so fighting there directly affects global oil and container shipping.
news.whyZh: 曼德海峡已成霍尔木兹海峡的替代航道，战事直接影响全球石油和集装箱运输。
news.detailEn: Options range from a narrow push around Bab el-Mandeb to synchronized attacks on several fronts, possibly mobilizing more than 100,000 Yemeni troops backed by Saudi air strikes. The US is providing intelligence but is not expected to join combat for now. Estimates for the launch range from within a week to after the US midterms. With Brent crude still above $100 a barrel, any disruption or reopening of the Red Sea route could swing energy prices sharply.
news.detailZh: 沙特考虑两种方案：只围绕曼德海峡的局部进攻，或多条战线同步推进，可能动员超过10万名也门士兵，并由沙特空军支援。美国目前提供情报，但暂不直接参战。外界估计行动最快一周内启动，也可能推迟到美国中期选举之后。布伦特原油仍在每桶100美元以上，红海航道的任何变化都可能大幅影响能源价格。

news.titleEn: Stocks remain under the thrall of higher yields and higher oil. Here's what's ahead
news.conclusionEn: Stocks rallied Friday as yields eased after weak jobs data, with the Nasdaq closing at a record, but oil and bond yields remain the key risks for the week ahead.
news.conclusionZh: 周五美股因收益率回落上涨、纳指创新高，但油价和利率仍是下周主要风险。
news.whyEn: Markets now price a roughly 85% chance the Fed holds in October; any surprise in oil or yields could quickly reverse the rally.
news.whyZh: 市场预计美联储10月按兵不动概率约85%，油价或利率的意外波动可能逆转涨势。
news.detailEn: The S&P 500 rose about 0.7% to 7,722 on Friday and the Nasdaq Composite gained about 1.1% to a record, after September payrolls rose just 29,000. Next week's data calendar is light, with the ISM services index on Monday and preliminary University of Michigan sentiment on Friday. Earnings from Constellation Brands, PepsiCo and Delta Air Lines will offer reads on consumers and fuel costs. The next Fed decision is on Oct. 27-28.
news.detailZh: 9月非农就业仅增加2.9万人后，周五标普500指数上涨约0.7%至7722点，纳斯达克综合指数涨约1.1%创收盘新高。下周数据不多，周一有ISM服务业指数，周五有密歇根大学消费者信心初值。星座品牌、百事和达美航空的财报将反映消费需求和燃油成本压力。美联储下次议息会议在10月27至28日。

news.titleEn: Brazil votes in high-stakes election as U.S.-China rivalry and debt loom large
news.conclusionEn: Brazilians vote on Oct. 4 in a tight first round between President Lula and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, with a runoff on Oct. 25 if no one wins a majority.
news.conclusionZh: 巴西10月4日举行首轮大选，卢拉与弗拉维奥·博索纳罗势均力敌。
news.whyEn: The result will shape Latin America's largest economy, its fiscal path and its stance between Washington and Beijing, and will move the real and Brazilian assets.
news.whyZh: 结果将影响拉美最大经济体的财政方向和中美之间的立场，牵动雷亚尔和巴西资产。
news.detailEn: Thirteen candidates are on the ballot, but the race is effectively between Lula of the Workers' Party and Flávio Bolsonaro, the 45-year-old eldest son of former President Jair Bolsonaro. Polls show Lula with a narrow lead, near 45% of valid votes, short of the majority needed to win outright. Investors are focused on Brazil's rising public debt and on how each candidate would handle relations with the US and China. A runoff on Oct. 25 looks likely.
news.detailZh: 本次共有13名候选人，但实际是劳工党的卢拉与前总统雅伊尔·博索纳罗45岁长子弗拉维奥之间的对决。民调显示卢拉小幅领先，有效票约45%，未达到首轮直接胜选所需的过半数。投资者关注巴西不断上升的公共债务，以及两位候选人如何处理对美、对华关系。10月25日举行第二轮投票的可能性很大。

news.titleEn: David Ellison just brought in a co-CEO to run his new empire: Meet Ynon Kreiz
news.conclusionEn: Outgoing Mattel CEO Ynon Kreiz will become co-CEO alongside David Ellison when Paramount's merger with Warner Bros. Discovery closes, expected Tuesday.
news.conclusionZh: 派拉蒙与华纳兄弟探索合并将完成，美泰CEO克雷兹出任联席CEO。
news.whyEn: The deal creates one of Hollywood's largest studios and streaming groups, reshaping competition with Netflix, Disney and Comcast.
news.whyZh: 合并将诞生好莱坞最大的影视和流媒体集团之一，改变与奈飞、迪士尼的竞争格局。
news.detailEn: The combined company will be named simply Skydance. Ellison will focus on strategy, creative direction, technology and capital allocation, while Kreiz will run day-to-day operations and the integration of the two businesses. Kreiz, credited with Mattel's turnaround and the 'Barbie' film strategy, will also join the board. The integration will be a major test, given the combined company's debt and overlapping networks and streaming services.
news.detailZh: 合并后的公司将直接命名为Skydance。埃里森负责战略、创意方向、技术和资本配置，克雷兹负责日常运营和两家公司的整合。克雷兹曾带领美泰扭亏为盈，并主导了《芭比》电影战略，他也将进入董事会。考虑到合并后的债务以及重叠的电视网和流媒体业务，整合将是一大考验。

news.titleEn: Tesla reports 486,532 vehicle deliveries for third quarter, topping expectation
news.conclusionEn: Tesla delivered 486,532 vehicles in Q3, down 2.1% from a year earlier but well above Wall Street's estimate of about 461,000.
news.conclusionZh: 特斯拉三季度交付48.65万辆，同比降2.1%，但大幅超出预期。
news.whyEn: The beat eases fears about demand for Tesla's aging lineup and sets the tone for its upcoming earnings.
news.whyZh: 超预期缓解了市场对特斯拉需求的担忧，为即将公布的财报定下基调。
news.detailEn: Model 3 and Model Y made up 478,237 of the deliveries, with 8,295 from other models. Production was about 464,000, below deliveries, suggesting Tesla drew down inventory. The year-earlier quarter was a record, boosted by buyers rushing before the US EV tax credit expired. Investors are also watching the early rollout of Tesla's Cybercab robotaxi in Austin.
news.detailZh: 其中Model 3和Model Y交付47.82万辆，其他车型8295辆。产量约46.4万辆，低于交付量，说明公司消化了库存。去年同期创下纪录，部分原因是美国电动车税收抵免到期前的抢购潮。投资者也在关注特斯拉Cybercab无人出租车在奥斯汀的早期运营情况。

news.titleEn: Treasury Sec. Bessent, IRS crack down on ETF strategy the wealthy are using to avoid capital gains taxes
news.conclusionEn: The Treasury and IRS warned that 'Section 351' ETF conversions used only to dodge capital gains taxes do not work under existing law.
news.conclusionZh: 美财政部和国税局警告：借351条款ETF规避资本利得税的做法不合法。
news.whyEn: It hits a fast-growing corner of the ETF industry that has raised at least $21 billion, and affects wealthy investors and their advisers.
news.whyZh: 冲击已募资至少210亿美元的ETF细分市场，影响富裕投资者及其顾问。
news.detailEn: In a 351 conversion, investors contribute appreciated stocks to a newly formed ETF in exchange for its shares, deferring tax on the gains. Regulators object when the ETF is merely a conduit, for example when it quickly distributes securities and leaves the investor with a materially different portfolio without ever recognizing gains. The new revenue ruling signals possible audits and penalties. Fund sponsors and advisers will likely rethink new launches built on this structure.
news.detailZh: 所谓351转换，是投资者把已大幅增值的股票注入新成立的ETF换取份额，从而递延资本利得税。监管机构反对把ETF仅仅当作「通道」的做法，例如ETF很快分出证券，让投资者在从未确认收益的情况下换成一套明显不同的持仓。新的税务裁定意味着可能面临审计和处罚。基金发行方和顾问可能会重新评估基于这一结构的新产品。

news.titleEn: Cerebras stock hits post-IPO low, tumbling 20% for the week on Nvidia pressure and lockup expiration
news.conclusionEn: AI chipmaker Cerebras fell nearly 20% this week to its lowest since its May IPO after losing an OpenAI inference workload to Nvidia and as insider shares unlocked.
news.conclusionZh: AI芯片商Cerebras本周跌近20%，创IPO以来新低。
news.whyEn: It shows how hard it is to challenge Nvidia, and how lockup expirations can weigh on hot tech IPOs.
news.whyZh: 说明挑战英伟达之难，以及禁售期到期对热门科技IPO的压力。
news.detailEn: Cerebras' market value has dropped to just over $39 billion from about $95 billion on its first trading day. It lost a key inference workload for OpenAI's 'Ultrafast' mode to Nvidia. CEO Andrew Feldman and CTO Sean Lie sold more than $240 million of shares from late August to late September, and up to 14.6 million shares unlock every two weeks. The stock rose almost 3% after hours on Friday after OpenAI CEO Sam Altman addressed speculation about the partnership.
news.detailZh: Cerebras市值已从上市首日的约950亿美元降至略高于390亿美元。公司在OpenAI「Ultrafast」模式的一项关键推理业务上输给了英伟达。CEO费尔德曼和CTO Sean Lie在8月底至9月底间出售了超过2.4亿美元股票，且每两周最多有1460万股解禁。OpenAI CEO奥特曼回应双方合作的传闻后，该股周五盘后上涨近3%。

news.titleEn: North Korea's Kim Oversaw Hypersonic Missile Drill, KCNA Says
news.conclusionEn: North Korea fired an intermediate-range hypersonic missile on Saturday, overseen by Kim Jong Un, hitting a target about 1,000 km away.
news.conclusionZh: 朝鲜周六试射中程高超音速导弹，金正恩亲自督导。
news.whyEn: The test raises tensions in Northeast Asia and challenges US, South Korean and Japanese missile defenses.
news.whyZh: 试射加剧东北亚紧张局势，并考验美日韩的导弹防御能力。
news.detailEn: State media said the drill trained units operating a hypersonic strategic weapon system and tested its reliability and mobility. Kim Yo Jong claimed a 'wave-like trajectory' prevented South Korea and Japan from tracking it. South Korea's military said it detected the launch and that the missile flew more than 700 km toward the sea. The launch follows rising tension after a landmine blast in the DMZ last month wounded South Korean soldiers.
news.detailZh: 官方媒体称，这次演练旨在训练高超音速战略武器部队，并检验系统的可靠性和机动性。金与正声称导弹的「波浪式弹道」让韩日无法追踪。韩国军方则表示探测到了发射，导弹向东部海域飞行了700多公里。上个月非军事区地雷爆炸导致韩国士兵受伤后，半岛局势持续升温。

news.titleEn: Trump to give $90 to senior citizens for Medicare premiums
news.conclusionEn: Trump said more than 20 million Medicare Part B enrollees will get a one-time $90 payment from the Medicare Improvement Fund to offset premiums.
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普宣布向逾2000万医保B部分参保人一次性发放90美元。
news.whyEn: The roughly $1.8 billion payout comes a month before the midterms and highlights rising healthcare costs for older Americans.
news.whyZh: 中期选举前一个月发放约18亿美元，凸显美国老年人医疗成本上升的压力。
news.detailEn: Most eligible recipients should get direct deposits in early October, with others receiving mailed checks. People whose premiums are paid by Medicaid, and higher earners who pay income-related surcharges, are excluded. The standard monthly Part B premium is $202.90. Critics say the timing, ahead of the Nov. 3 elections when control of Congress is at stake, is political.
news.detailZh: 大部分符合条件者将在10月初通过银行直接入账收到款项，其余人会收到邮寄支票。保费由Medicaid支付的人，以及需缴纳收入相关附加费的高收入者不在发放范围内。目前B部分的标准月保费为202.90美元。批评者认为，在11月3日决定国会控制权的选举前发钱，带有明显的政治考量。

businessTips.explanationEn: Post-merger integration is the work of combining two companies after a deal closes: systems, teams, culture, products and costs. Most of a merger's promised value, its 'synergies', is won or lost here, not at signing. Research consistently finds that many deals fail to deliver expected value because integration is underplanned. Good PMI starts before closing, with a clear owner, a 100-day plan and a few measurable priorities.
businessTips.explanationZh: 并购后整合（PMI）是指交易完成后把两家公司真正合在一起的工作，包括系统、团队、文化、产品和成本。并购承诺的大部分价值，也就是「协同效应」，是在这一阶段实现或丢掉的，而不是在签约时。大量研究发现，许多并购没能兑现预期价值，主要原因就是整合准备不足。好的整合在交易完成前就开始，有明确负责人、百日计划和少数可量化的优先目标。
businessTips.exampleEn: In the Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery deal, Ellison split roles so that a co-CEO, Ynon Kreiz, owns daily operations and integration. That gives one leader clear accountability for merging overlapping streaming services and networks while the other focuses on strategy.
businessTips.exampleZh: 在派拉蒙与华纳兄弟探索的合并中，埃里森明确分工，由联席CEO克雷兹负责日常运营和整合。这样合并重叠流媒体和电视网的工作有一个明确的责任人，另一位领导者则专注战略。

businessTips.explanationEn: An owned audience is a group of people you can reach directly, such as an email list or SMS list, without depending on a platform's algorithm. Followers on social media are 'rented': reach can drop overnight if the algorithm changes or an account is banned. For side businesses, a list of even a few hundred engaged subscribers can generate steady sales. It also lets you test ideas and pre-sell products cheaply.
businessTips.explanationZh: 自有受众是指你能直接触达的人群，比如邮件订阅列表或短信列表，不依赖平台算法。社交媒体粉丝更像是「租来的」，一旦算法调整或账号被封，触达率可能一夜之间下降。对副业来说，哪怕只有几百个活跃订阅者，也能带来稳定的销售。它还能让你低成本测试想法、预售产品。
businessTips.exampleEn: A designer who posts templates on Instagram adds a free template download that requires an email address. A year later, when Instagram reach falls, they launch a paid template pack to 2,000 subscribers and make most of their sales from that single email.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位在Instagram发布设计模板的设计师，提供留邮箱即可免费下载模板的入口。一年后Instagram流量下滑，这位设计师向2000名订阅者发布付费模板包，大部分销量都来自那一封邮件。

businessTips.explanationEn: Tax-loss harvesting means selling investments that are below your purchase price to realize a loss, which can offset taxable capital gains elsewhere in your portfolio. You can then reinvest in a similar, but not 'substantially identical', asset to stay invested. In the US, the wash-sale rule disallows the loss if you buy the same security within 30 days. It is a legitimate tool, unlike aggressive schemes regulators are now targeting, but it defers taxes rather than eliminating them.
businessTips.explanationZh: 税损收割是指卖出低于买入价的投资来实现亏损，用它抵消组合中其他资产的应税资本利得。之后可以买入相似但不「实质相同」的资产，保持市场敞口。在美国，如果30天内买回同一证券，「洗售规则」会让这笔亏损不能抵税。这是合法工具，不同于监管正在打击的激进避税方案，但它只是递延税负，而不是消除税负。
businessTips.exampleEn: An investor has a $5,000 gain on Nvidia and a $3,000 loss on a clean-energy ETF. Selling the ETF and buying a different clean-energy fund locks in the $3,000 loss, so only $2,000 of net gains is taxed this year while the investor keeps similar exposure.
businessTips.exampleZh: 某投资者在英伟达上有5000美元收益，在一只清洁能源ETF上亏损3000美元。卖出这只ETF并买入另一只清洁能源基金，就能确认3000美元亏损，今年只需为2000美元净收益缴税，同时保持类似的投资敞口。
